args.title: Historical Note: Alex’s Informal Responsibility for Older Services
args.body:
On May 2, 2023, Alex’s runbook-audit inventory identified two older services he treated as informal responsibility because ownership was incomplete: legacy-aggregator and metric-rollup.

Legacy-aggregator was still involved in migration-era behavior and recurring cardinality and bucket-flush issues, so Alex “kinda owned” it while the migration was unfinished. Metric-rollup was a separate, deprecated service that was effectively unowned in practice. It was not the same as rollup-service, the active downstream service later owned by the Data Platform/Cyrus team. Alex’s later guidance was to leave metric-rollup untouched and name rollup-service explicitly in operational references.
